name: Freeform — the named escape hatch
description: One unconstrained stage: any number of workers, with or without a worktree of their own.

freeform.description: For work with nothing to plan or review — answer a question, read a log, run a command, or fan out one investigator per independent question in a single turn. Brief the goal and its sentinel. Nothing here is enforced, so whatever the job must not do belongs in your brief: a worker without its own worktree is in the live project tree, where "change nothing" is an instruction rather than a guarantee. Give it `createWorktree: true` when it may write code, and land that worktree as you would any other.
